name: YLO Cobras
description: The YLO Cobras (Young Latino Organization Cobras) are a Puerto Rican Folk Nation street gang based in Logan Square, Chicago. They emerged from the Young Latino Organization (YLO), a joint program of the Spanish Cobras and Maniac Latin Disciples, and became a distinct gang in 1980 when the YLO split into the YLO Cobras and YLO Disciples.
